input.summary: Add a Customer 60-day non-renewal notice right
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement auto-renews for 1-year terms and our only exit is the mutual 90-day post-Initial-Term notice, so we have added a Customer non-renewal election on 60 days' notice before the end of the then-current Term, consistent with our fallback position of a non-renewal window of no more than 60 days. Kubient's 90-day notice right is untouched.

ops.text: Customer may elect not to renew this Agreement by giving written notice of non-renewal to Kubient at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current Term, in which case this Agreement will expire at the end of that Term.
